name: Frogly
description: Decoys your traders never see. When an automated intruder takes one, Frogly records it. Free: 10 catches a month, no sign-up. See them at frogly.ai/orderly with your DEX wallet. Pro adds the maze, a fake back office that keeps intruders busy away from your DEX.
usagePrompt:
Add Frogly to a custom Orderly SDK v3 app.

1. Install once:
   pnpm add @froglylabs/orderly-plugin

2. Register it on OrderlyAppProvider. No settings are needed. Register it once and never behind a condition:

   import { registerFroglyPlugin } from "@froglylabs/orderly-plugin";

   <OrderlyAppProvider
     {...existingProps}
     plugins={[registerFroglyPlugin()]}
   >
     {children}
   </OrderlyAppProvider>

3. Content Security Policy (if the host sets one):
   - script-src https://cdn.frogly.ai
   - connect-src https://cdn.frogly.ai https://api.frogly.ai

4. Do not pass claimCode from app code. The optional claim code is only for DEX Creator's public config.js; Frogly's server reads it there. The plugin ignores it at run time.

5. siteId is code-only, for a DEX that already has a Frogly site:
   plugins={[registerFroglyPlugin({}, { siteId: "existing-site-id" })]}
   Otherwise omit it. The plugin derives the site ID from the Orderly broker ID.

6. The plugin wraps Account.AccountMenu and Account.MobileAccountMenu, adds Frogly's pinned core script once, and fails open. It does not read wallet, account, order, or position data.
